comments.author: Gunga_Din
comments.body: Don't waste time or money trying to mod this ship. I tried to add a Ram and rowing assistance..both failed to add skill. So stats are the same as the Adventure class galley but it wont take the skills. You can add an original ship skill to it however.

comments.author: Taipan
comments.body:
Frankly, modding or adding an Original Ship Skill to any SO, Memorial or Graduation ship is a waste of time, ducats, FS parts, SSIP and or OSP.
